about.title: Who I Am
about.description: I’m a 19-year-old coder with a passion for crafting awesome web apps! From slick front-ends to robust back-ends, I love bringing ideas to life. When I’m not coding, you’ll find me diving into fantasy RPGs or rolling dice in Dungeons & Dragons – those epic worlds spark my creativity. I’m all about self-improvement, healthy living, and soaking up new tech to level up my projects.

points.education: I’m an IT student in high school, but I spend my nights mastering cutting-edge tools like Vue, Nuxt, and TypeScript.
points.experience: I’ve tackled commercial and nonprofit projects, building everything from e-commerce platforms to educational tools and custom solutions.
